judgements.source_sql: SELECT dt.d_year, item.i_brand_id AS brand_id, item.i_brand AS brand, SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS sum_agg FROM workspace.nirvana_tpcds.date_dim AS dt CROSS JOIN workspace.nirvana_tpcds.store_sales CROSS JOIN workspace.nirvana_tpcds.item WHERE dt.d_date_sk = store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk AND store_sales.ss_item_sk = item.i_item_sk AND item.i_manufact_id = 128 AND dt.d_moy = 11 GROUP BY dt.d_year, item.i_brand, item.i_brand_id ORDER BY dt.d_year, sum_agg DESC, brand_id LIMIT 100
